Company IT security policy
Synthetic policy for the Document Intelligence project. Not a real company policy.
Password requirements
Account passwords must contain at least 14 characters. Use a unique passphrase for every work
account. Do not reuse personal passwords. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for email, remote
access and the HR portal.
Access approval
The employee's line manager approves requests for business-system access. The IT Service Desk
provisions approved access using the least-privilege principle. Shared accounts are prohibited.

Company IT security policy
Synthetic policy for the Document Intelligence project. Not a real company policy.
Security incidents
The Security Operations team is responsible for triaging security incidents. Employees must report
suspected incidents to the IT Service Desk within 30 minutes of discovery. Preserve suspicious
messages and do not forward them to colleagues.
Document handling
Store internal documents only in approved company storage. Do not send restricted documents to
public AI services without explicit organizational authorization. Remove access promptly when an
employee leaves the company.

Employee leave policy
Synthetic policy for the Document Intelligence project. Not a real company policy.
Annual leave entitlement
Employees at Northstar Labs receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. The leave year
runs from January 1 to December 31. Public holidays are separate from the annual leave entitlement.
Carry-forward
Employees may carry forward up to 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year. Carried
days must be used by March 31. Additional carry-forward requires written approval from Human
Resources.

Employee leave policy
Synthetic policy for the Document Intelligence project. Not a real company policy.
Requesting leave
Submit a leave request through the HR portal at least 5 working days before the planned start date.
The line manager approves or declines the request within 2 working days. Human Resources
maintains the leave balance.
Urgent absence
For an unexpected absence, notify the line manager before 10:00 AM on the first day whenever
practical. Record the request in the HR portal when able. This policy does not specify parental leave
or compensation rates.

Project management guidelines
Synthetic policy for the Document Intelligence project. Not a real company policy.
Project milestone stages
Every project uses five milestone stages: initiation, planning, implementation, validation and closure.
The project manager maintains the milestone register and assigns an owner to each deliverable.
Milestone approval
The project sponsor approves milestone completion after reviewing the acceptance evidence. During
validation, the quality lead records test outcomes and unresolved defects. A milestone cannot close
with an unresolved critical defect.

Project management guidelines
Synthetic policy for the Document Intelligence project. Not a real company policy.
Delivery and reporting
The project manager publishes a weekly status report each Friday. The report includes completed
work, upcoming milestones, risks and decisions needed. Changes to scope require sponsor approval
before implementation.
Leave and handover
Team members planning leave must prepare a handover note listing active tasks, deadlines and
backup owners. The line manager approves the leave request under the employee leave policy. The
project manager updates the delivery plan.
